My story

A question that changed my career.

When Simon asked what I was most passionate about in my career, my answer was immediate: AI. I believed it would fundamentally change how we work—and I was excited by the impact we could create together.

Simon encouraged me to take a bold leap and reach out directly to Citi’s Global Chief Technology Officer. That trust opened an unexpected door. From there, we turned a personal conviction into shared momentum—exploring practical use cases, building capability, and helping colleagues work more effectively.

“This is why I help young people. He is enthusiastic about AI, so I suggested contacting Citi’s Chief Technology Officer directly. Now John is one of Citi’s leading AI experts. Proud of you, John!”

Simon Clarke · Managing Director at Citi Private Bank
01

Someone believed first

My mentor Simon Clarke heard my conviction for AI transformation and encouraged me to reach out directly to Citi’s Global CTO. That act of sponsorship opened doors I never expected.

02

I stepped beyond my role

I took on stretch AI assignments alongside my daily banking work—learning through rejection, pushback, technical hurdles, and the responsibility to create genuine value.

03

Trust became transformation

With supportive leaders and teammates, we established the Citi AI Solution Lab and turned grassroots experimentation into practical enterprise adoption.

Live demonstration of Citi Stylus Workspaces to Hong Kong CEO Aveline San and senior leaders.

Enterprise transformation

Reverse mentoring built on trust.

AI transformation cannot live in an ivory tower. It works when frontline colleagues understand how it respects their expertise and removes daily friction.

By pairing curious junior talent with experienced leadership, we showed that AI is not merely a technology initiative. It is a human evolution—built through psychological safety, intellectual honesty, and the courage to challenge established routines.

“Technology is never the end goal; human enablement is.”

Contributions & impact

Turning AI ambition into capability.

Our work sits at the intersection of strategy, use-case development, executive engagement, and practical adoption. Together, we connect global direction with the daily realities of bankers, control teams, and clients.

Strategy

AI leadership & strategy

Recognized as a Year-End AI MVP, I supported Citi’s AI transformation by pitching strategies to global senior leadership and facilitating AI strategy across the US, Europe, Hong Kong, and Singapore. I am driving banker-focused AI development for the KYC Source of Wealth process—bridging bankers, clients, and review teams to reduce friction and return frontline capacity to client engagement and revenue-generating work.

US · Europe · Hong Kong · Singapore · KYC Source of Wealth

Programmes

Global programme & use-case development

As a founding member of the CEO-sponsored AI Solution Lab, I helped drive cross-functional use-case development and implementation. I also contributed to the global AI Engagement Program, built resources for teams worldwide, and participated in the Citi Stylus Workspaces pilot before its launch to 150,000 colleagues globally.

CEO-sponsored AI Solution Lab · 150,000 colleagues globally

Enablement

Local & global enablement

I showcased AI capabilities to 1,700+ colleagues across 28+ sessions, from CEOs, COOs, CAOs, CFOs, and business leaders in Private Bank, Wealth, Corporate Bank, and TTS to functional leaders in BCM, Cybersecurity, and Controls. Dedicated sessions reached extended leadership, JANA Management Trainees, and Internal Audit teams across eight countries. I was also nominated to demonstrate AI to 500+ colleagues at Citi Hong Kong AI Days.

1,700+ colleagues · 28+ sessions · 8 countries · 500+ AI Days audience

Skills

Practical upskilling

We promoted Copilot and internal AI tools through targeted everyday use cases, while I facilitated learning on AI foundations, prompt engineering, Claude and Gemini, presentation generation, and token efficiency. I interviewed senior leaders on AI integration and developed an AI dashboard to support management decisions.

Copilot · Claude · Gemini · AI dashboard

Mentoring

AI reverse mentoring

We helped pair 30+ senior leaders with AI enthusiasts. Through tailored, continuous engagement, we bridged the knowledge gap, created genuine cross-learning, and helped leaders accelerate adoption across their teams.

30+ senior leaders · Continuous cross-learning

From grassroots to global scale

Practical AI, made real.

Together, we helped pilot tools that scaled to approximately 150,000 colleagues worldwide, while I led sessions for more than 1,700 teammates. The goal was never adoption for its own sake: it was smarter workflows, better judgment, and more time for colleagues to serve clients with empathy.

Recognition & responsibility

The award belongs to everyone who advocated for me.

Being named Citi Hong Kong’s Year-End AI MVP was deeply humbling. I see the recognition not as a finish line, but as a responsibility to uphold high standards, stay grounded, and ensure others receive the same chances I was given.

Skills can be taught, but character, credibility, and trust are built over time.

Paying it forward

Helping young people become more than prompt users.

My mentors taught me that a meaningful legacy is built by opening doors. That lesson led me to mentor secondary-school students during Citi’s AI Day with the SEED Foundation’s IdeaPOP! programme.

Youth employability in the AI era is not about memorizing prompt tricks. It depends on durable human qualities: critical inquiry, empathy, responsible judgment, and the resilience to treat setbacks as learning feedback.

An adaptive AI apprenticeship vision

  • Workflow orchestration for practical, non-technical AI builders
  • Human-in-the-loop governance for responsible decision-making
  • Local SME integration for real impact and durable careers

Gratitude & community

No transformation happens alone.

These milestones were made possible by mentors, senior sponsors, AI champions, and teammates who challenged and supported me. Their belief shaped my career; their example shapes how I now show up for others.
